text:
maya (events): Quick silly idea  casual 'Curry & Karaoke' pop-up next Fri? small group, curry sharing + 3-song karaoke slots. Venue picks: 1) Spice Alley (private nook), 2) Corner Bar (mic + cheap drafts), 3) Office Commons (bring our amp). Start 7:00 or 8:00? RSVP + whether youd sing. :microphone: :curry: :notes:

ben: Spice Alley for the food. 8:00 better for me. happy to do a rock trio slot.

olga: Office Commons if we can borrow an amp. 7:00 for me. vegetarian + no dairy. ill sing a couple calm pop songs if theres a piano backing.

trent: Corner Bar sounds fun. 8:00  ill bring a small travel speaker and buy first round. 

mia: leaning Spice Alley but flexible. 7:00 ok. ill take a karaoke slot and do some guilty-pleasure 90s pop. :sweat_smile:

leo: if Office Commons, i can lug the amp and a mic stand. 7:00 preferred. not singing this time, will MC.

maya (events): Nice spread. Putting up a short ops-bot poll for venue/time. If Spice Alley wins ill ask about a shared curry menu and veg-friendly options; Corner Bar ill check mic setup; Office Commons ill reserve the corner and coordinate amp pickup. Also thinking a 3-song limit per person so we get through folks.

ops-bot: Poll: "Curry & Karaoke Fri - pick venue & start"  Spice Alley  3 votes  8:00  Corner Bar  1 vote  8:00  Office Commons  2 votes  7:00 (ends in 8h)

olga: FYI Spice Alley has a decent dal and coconut veg curry. if they win ill pre-order a dairy-free platter.

ben: if Spice Alley wins ill handle the split payment for the shared mains.

mia: adding a tentative to calendar. curious if we should do a silly prize (best backup dancer?). :trophy:

maya (events): Ill lock the winner tomorrow morning and post final plan + sign-up for song slots. If you havent voted, react to ops-bot or reply here. Small rule: 3-song max, keep profanity light. See you for curry and questionable singing! :sparkles:
